payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the inference models used to estimate socioeconomic status (SES) based on various data sources and methodologies.

claims.text: The inference model for estimating socioeconomic status (SES) uses a combination of socioeconomic census data, crawled professional profiles, and expert annotated images of users' home locations.
The model classifies users into lower and higher SES classes based on average income and expert annotations, defining the inference task as a two-way classification problem.
Previous works have applied Gaussian Processes to predict user income and SES based on demographic and psycho-linguistic features.
